status: DRAFT ONLY — NOT CLEARED FOR SOCIAL PUBLICATION
purpose: User-authorized public repository storage of a fresh draft capability test; not an Instagram publication.
claim: CVE-2026-42069 describes HTML2Shell, a critical HTML remote-code-execution vulnerability.
context: A satirical graphic misuses a real CVE identifier. No deceptive intent or reach figure is asserted.
evidence_summary: The official Kirby advisory identifies missing read-access controls for authenticated Panel users, potentially exposing site, user and role information. It does not describe remote code execution in HTML. Fixed in Kirby 4.9.0 and 5.4.0. This does not rule out actual browser or web-app vulnerabilities.
